title: LeapQuant: Efficient Linear Attention with Accurate Recurrent State Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2609.38166v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent LLMs increasingly adopt hybrid designs that replace standard attention with linear attention, such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA). Although they compress the context into a fixed-size recurrent state and substantially reduce the cost of long-context processing, repeatedly reading and updating that state remains a major inference bottleneck. Quantization offers a natural way to reduce this cost, but can significantly degrade model quality, due to the accumulation of rounding errors and the presence of outlier rows and columns in the state. To address these challenges, we propose LeapQuant, a training-free method that achieves near-lossless performance under 8-bit recurrent-state quantization. First, to mitigate error accumulation, we propose per-window quantization, which leaps over a window of tokens and quantizes the state only once at its end. translated_title: LeapQuant：基于精确循环状态量化的高效线性注意力
translated_abstract: 近期的大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地采用混合设计，用线性注意力（如 Gated DeltaNet (GDN) 和 Kimi Delta Attention (KDA)）替代标准注意力。尽管这些方法将上下文压缩为固定大小的循环状态，大幅降低了长上下文处理的成本，但反复读取和更新该状态仍是推理过程中的主要瓶颈。量化是降低这一成本的自然途径，但由于舍入误差的累积以及状态中异常行列的存在，量化可能显著降低模型质量。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 LeapQuant，这是一种无需训练的方法，在 8 位循环状态量化下实现了近乎无损的性能。首先，为减轻误差累积，我们提出了按窗口量化，即跳过一个 token 窗口，仅在窗口结束时对状态量化一次。在窗口内部，输出由固定的低比特……（摘要至此截断）
tldr: LeapQuant 提出了一种无需训练的按窗口量化方法，通过跳过整个 token 窗口、仅在窗口末尾对循环状态量化一次来避免误差累积，从而在 8 位循环状态量化下实现近乎无损的线性注意力推理性能。
en_tdlr: LeapQuant is a training-free quantization method that leaps over a window of tokens and quantizes the recurrent state only once at window ends, mitigating error accumulation to achieve near-lossless linear attention performance under 8-bit recurrent-state quantization.
